title: Identical laws of multilinear evaluations
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ and $(\Xi,\nu)$ be probability spaces, and let $F$ be a real coefficient family on subsets of the $n$ coordinates. Suppose the coordinate families $X_i:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ and $Y_i:\Xi\to\mathbb R$ are each independent, and that $X_i$ and $Y_i$ have the same distribution for every coordinate $i$. Then the multilinear evaluations $\sum_S F(S)\prod_{i\in S}X_i$ and $\sum_S F(S)\prod_{i\in S}Y_i$ have the same distribution under $\mu$ and $\nu$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real coefficient family on coordinate subsets
